dilution: Dissolve in 200 Litres of water per acre (500 L/ha) for uniform foliar spray
application_method: Foliar spray at the first appearance of yellow/brown rust pustules
safety_precautions: Wear protective nose mask, eye goggles, and chemical-resistant gloves during spray preparation
Do not spray during high winds (>15 km/h) or under direct midday sun
Keep cattle and grazing animals out of treated field for at least 15 days
Dispose of empty containers safely as per CIB&RC environmental guidelines
